# E0252: a published version was removed

A published version may have instances, so it is never removed. Here the
candidate's history/ stops at 0.0, and 0.1, which was published, is gone.

## Example

`candidate/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`published/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`published/ship/history/0.1.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name:  string
	size?: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0252]: the lineage removes published version 0.1
  |
  = note: the schema in history/0.1.thema was published, so instances of it may exist
  = help: restore the schema in history/0.1.thema as it was published; a published version is never removed
```
